versions.changelog: The client reads no environment variable except the API key (request timeout is now a constant).

Answer the security audit: honest 'social media and web data' framing; personal-contact endpoints (linkedin/profile-contact, google_maps/contacts) refused by call_endpoint.js and include_email dropped; new Personal data section; request host is a constant; allowed-tools and network declared.

Harden the HTTP client: the API key is only ever sent to api.scrapersocial.com; an environment override is honoured for loopback hosts only (test suite). Addresses static-analysis finding suspicious.env_credential_access.
